name: Affiliate Contact Form 7 Integration For WooCommerce
author: storeapps

sections.description:
Create custom affiliate registration forms with full control over the fields and allow users to sign up for your affiliate program.

The Affiliate for WooCommerce plugin and Contact Form 7 i.e. CF7 integration allows you to set up custom forms (new form fields) and get more essential information from affiliates.

Trusted by 5700+ paid users, Affiliate for WooCommerce enables you to set up and run your successful affiliate program. Track referrals, sales, and commissions, manage payouts, create campaigns and more from one place.

Requirements

Install and activate Affiliate for WooCommerce plugin and Contact Form 7 or CF7 plugin, and WooCommerce, ofcourse.

Recruit better affiliates for brand promotion

With this Contact Form 7 addon, you will see eight new form tags (reference) for affiliate registration. These tags, each with a prefix ‘Affiliate Registration’ allows you to add all the default affiliate registration fields:

  • Email Address
  • First Name
  • Last Name
  • Password
  • Confirm Password
  • PayPal Email Address
  • Referral affiliate user ID
  • Website URL

But go beyond and customize the form to collect crucial details to assess each affiliate’s potential:

  • Phone number / WhatsApp number
  • Social profiles
  • Audience size
  • Industry or niche
  • Promotional methods (blogs, emails, social, ads)
  • Bank details
  • Tax details – VAT or GST number
  • Mailing address and country
  • Reasons to join your affiliate program
  • Terms and conditions
    and other fields…

Atleast make email, first name and last name, password, terms and conditions mandatory without fail.

By gathering all the additional information, you can better evaluate the affiliates’ ability to promote your brand effectively.

So you can accept or reject affiliate requests and recruit quality affiliates for your program. Who knows, you may have influencers on board!

Once your form is set up, insert the Contact Form 7 shortcode to any post/page of your site, and your affiliate registration will be live for prospective affiliates to sign up for your program.
sections.installation:
1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Click on ‘Affiliate Contact Form 7 Integration For WooCommerce’ option within WordPress admin > WooCommerce
sections.faq:
1. Can I add unlimited form fields?

Yes, but do not overwhelm affiliates. Keep minimal fields, but make them mandatory.

2. Does this require any coding?

Not at all. It’s very easy. More details here.
